declaration_is_not_an_attestation.statement: harness/independence.py verifies no layer list is complete, and an undeclared shared layer is exactly the fault the structure cannot see. independence_decl.check_anchors pins ten attribute names against drift, which catches a rename that would make a layer name a fiction; ten anchors are not a completeness proof.

route3_cannot_decide_an_integer.statement: Route 3 is measured, float grade at mpmath dps 130, by construction. It cannot decide an integer and does not claim to; its job is to catch a wrong one. So the second witness at the headline t = 36/625 is a float agreement, not a second enclosure.

boxes_differ_between_routes.statement: route 1 and route 2 use overlapping but different boxes; both decide N = 1, but no single artifact says so in one place.

sharper_strip_not_adopted.statement: Bombieri-Ghosh's sigma(tau_+, 1) = 1.120362 would improve the upper bound by a factor 2.082, but it is cited plus measured rather than decided. Not adopted.

academia_edu_166936409_unread.statement: The one source bearing on the claim still unread; its recovered abstract fragments describe measured lifetimes of Davenport-Heilbronn off-line zeros under this same backward flow, so it may contain, implicitly, a float-grade lower bound. Its provenance could not be determined from inside this checkout.

dobner_citation_sweep_single_source.statement: The forward-citation search on Dobner ran on Semantic Scholar alone, because OpenAlex returned HTTP 429 with zero daily allowance. Repeat against Google Scholar or MathSciNet.

decay_monotonicity_discharge_gap.statement: THEOREM13.md section 5.3 discharges the b > 2 decay hypothesis with a 201-point grid asserting a margin function is increasing on [2, 30], a bounded-range check standing in for an unbounded-range claim. The fact is immediate from the artifact's own domination and one derivative line settles it, so this is a discharge gap and not a doubt.

bombieri_mueller_unconsulted.statement: Bombieri-Mueller, 'On the zeros of certain Epstein zeta functions', Forum Math. 20:2 (2008), the parent of the constant that displaced sigma_0, has not been consulted.

classical_facts_not_proved_in_tree.statement: Gamma has no zeros and only the simple poles at s = -1, -3, ...; F is entire with F(s) = F(1-s) (structural, measured in-tree to defect about 1e-50 and test-pinned). Both are used without an in-tree proof.

residual_float_grade_steps.statement: The dps-112 locating pass that places the boxes, the whole WP3 census, and calibration.json's re-derivation of the Delta^2/2 dictionary are float grade. None is load-bearing and all three are labelled measured in the artifacts.
